body: mnemosyne key towers. They're only 2 floors and a full clear will net you 12501 tower shards every time, much more than 10 floor towers. Only available during the of giants and titans event, so make use of it while it's around!

author: permaculturegeek
body:
1) If you are simply farming shards and not augments, exit without fighting when you reach the Titan's floor. You keep all shards earned that way.

2) 10 floor towers are pretty useless for shard farming. The floor level is part of the shards per guardian level, so a guardian on floor 40 yields approximately 40x as many as one on floor 1.

author: bombolopanzo
body: Not directly an answer to your question but as a fellow t10 newbie (just hit lvl 233), I'm currently running towers as a beowulf with arisen spiritgarm and Fey cactus for horde mobs. This way I can easily climb 50 floor towers (without killing the final boss) without issues. I still use grand summoner for other contents but for towers switching to beo has been a great improvement and the nice thing is that basically the gear you want is the same as summoner, just stack up as much ward as you can and let the pet do your job.
